info.title: School Account Portal Integration
info.description: Backend contract for eight distinct accounting workspaces: journals/general ledger/trial balance, bank-statement matching, balance sheets, tax and SSNIT rates, released PV receipts, audit diffs, account setup, and checked period closing. See accounting-portal-backend-handoff.txt for permission, state and financial rules. Required integration, not a claim of live service availability.
